references.text: Jacob also blesses Pharaoh upon his arrival, which frames the conversation with Pharaoh.
Melchizedek blesses Abram, another example of a blessing given by a servant of God to a secular ruler.
Isaac blesses Jacob before he departs for Paddan-Aram, illustrating the significance of blessings in the lives of the patriarchs.
Jacob blesses Ephraim and Manasseh, continuing the tradition of giving blessings.
The book of Hebrews states the principle that the lesser is blessed by the greater, which sheds light on Jacob's blessing of Pharaoh—spiritually speaking, Jacob is the greater one.
Highlights God's continuous blessing over Jacob through various stages of life.
